title: ‘Breaking Bad’ star Dean Norris lists California ranch for $3.2 million amid divorce and bankruptcy proceedings
summary_full: Dean Norris has listed his expansive 11-acre ranch in Temecula for an asking price of $3,199,267 amidst ongoing divorce proceedings. His wife, Bridget, filed for divorce due to irreconcilable differences, while also pursuing joint custody of their children. Compounding their challenges, the couple's restaurant, Swing Inn Cafe, has entered Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Featuring an infinity pool and horse barn, the ranch attracts potential buyers seeking luxury.
